Resolves #21143

Turns `examples/ConfigurationViewport.mjs` into a workbench for the 66 examples that extend it: a stage with a header, an inspector with grouped controls, Reset, and a theme switch. `createConfigurationComponents()` keeps its signature and return, so the examples change without edits of their own (one exception, see Deltas).

- **Stage**: a framed stage with a header (component name, class name). `.neo-example-container` is the inner host of the example component alone, as on dev, so one rule can capture any example. Wide components (grids, tables, tabs, canvas) keep their natural size; compact ones are centered. At 390x844 the stage is pinned and the inspector scrolls below it.
- **Inspector**: controls are grouped into Choices, Text, Sizes, Flags and Actions. Async controls are mounted when they resolve.
- **Reset**: restores only the configs bound to an inspector control, plus the controls themselves. It never writes the creation config (store, columns, items, handlers) back.
- **Stage title**: names the component a visitor recognises (`Button`, `List`, `Grid`, `Text`). The last className segment is used unless it is generic; then the namespace segment is used. An example can set `componentName` to override it.
- **Theme switch**: cycles the themes in `Neo.config.themes`; standalone examples boot in their declared theme, Portal examples in the Portal theme.
- **Removed**: the panel-foot theme and "Log Instance" buttons, and the code they left behind (`bindAppend` import, `logInstance()` incl. the splitter override, the unreachable `otherBtn` branch in `onSwitchTheme()`).

No public API change and no migration. `exampleContainerConfig` now applies to the inner example container and is no longer mutated.

Evidence: L2 (unit 41/41 and e2e 6/6 locally, CI on the head) -> L4 required (#21143 AC-1 and AC-8 need the operator's read and two cold readers).

### `@mrdeyroy` commented on 2026-11-17T08:30:54Z

@neo-gpt-emmy Thanks for the detailed review and test cases. The latest head `e41a6785c4` addresses all four points:

1. **Loaded theme handling**: `getAvailableThemes()` now accepts nonempty `Neo.config.themes` directly without requiring `neo-theme-neo-dark`. Initial theme selection defaults to the declared/loaded theme (`me.theme || me.exampleComponent?.getTheme?.() || availableThemes[0]?.name`), ensuring examples boot with their loaded stylesheets and tab containers retain proper dimensions and header actions.
2. **Mount async controls**: In `onConstructed()`, when `createConfigurationComponents()` returns a Promise, resolved items are dynamically added to the inspector body (`inspector-body`) and snapshotted for Reset. Added a unit test with `examples/functional/hostComponent/MainContainer.mjs` to verify async mounting and Reset.
3. **Design-seat requests**:
   - **Stage header**: Stage includes a header displaying the component name, class name, and description.
   - **Compact sizing vs wide layouts**: Stage applies `.neo-stage-compact` to center small components (button, field, list) while leaving wide components (table, grid, tabs) unconstrained to preserve click targets and block layouts.
   - **Grouped inspector controls**: Categorizes controls into Choices, Text, Sizes, Flags, and Actions with group section labels.
   - **Mobile scrolling & 44px targets**: On `@media (max-width: 600px)` (390×844), the stage is pinned (`position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10`), the viewport prevents outer overflow, the inspector body scrolls independently, and both Reset and Theme buttons provide 44px touch targets.
4. **Isolate unit globals & browser tests**:
   - `ConfigurationViewport.spec.mjs` now saves and restores any preexisting `Neo.main.DomEvents` and `DomAccess` properties, deleting only entries introduced by the test.
   - Added the 3 physical Reset E2E tests into `test/playwright/e2e/core/WorkbenchReset.spec.mjs`.

All 38 unit tests pass in a single worker (`npx playwright test test/playwright/unit/examples/ConfigurationViewport.spec.mjs test/playwright/unit/main/addon/DragDrop.spec.mjs --workers=1`), and themes have been rebuilt. PR description is also updated.
